neighbours.label: a parenthetical unit conversion, at the digits or the opening bracket (8,850 km (5,500 miles), 27 feet (8.2 m)), as opposed to other brackets and other numbers
fire: The river runs for 1,200 km (746 miles) through the plain.
The lake covers 300 square miles (777 km2) in all.
We drove a 160 km (100 mile) loop on Saturday.
The tower rises 40 feet (12.2 m) above the square.
Each span is 90 metres (295 feet) long.
The ship weighs 8,000 tonnes (8,800 tons) when loaded.
A fence of 15 km (9 miles) surrounds the base.
quiet: The river runs through the plain (according to old maps).
The lake covers 300 farms (the census says) in all.
We drove 160 friends to the fair on Saturday.
The tower rises above the square (see the photo).
Each span was built in 1890 by the state.
Temperatures fell in the valley (mostly at night).
The ship carries 8,000 people when loaded.
A fence (recently painted) surrounds the base.

notes: This does not cover the card's other peaks: acronym brackets ('PVC (') scored 0.48 in a probe, and non-numeric tokens such as ' Both' and Russian 'ложения' are also on the card.
